Known for aspirational, effortless style, we make getting dressed every day easy. Our three brands – DECJUBA, D-LUXE Basics and DECJUBA Kids – bring that vision to life season after season. Reimagined by Tania Austin in 2008, DECJUBA is female-owned and led, with more than 1,500 team members across our global Head Office and retail stores. Today, our retail footprint spans over 170 locations across Australia and New Zealand, alongside a growing global online presence. Because when our customers feel amazing, we know we’re doing what we do best. THE OPPORTUNITY Reporting to the IT Operations Manager, the IT Support Officer is responsible for delivering high-quality Level 1/2 IT support across our Support Office and national retail network. You’ll be the first point of contact for IT requests, providing hands-on support across hardware, software, networks and retail systems, while escalating more complex issues where required. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Provide responsive helpdesk support to head office and retail stores Support and troubleshoot laptops, desktops, mobile devices and peripherals Provide remote support to stores across POS, connectivity and hardware Manage user accounts (Active Directory / M365) in line with IT processes Maintain asset registers and device lifecycle management Monitor and respond to alerts via RMM and security systems Assist with network troubleshooting across store WAN/LAN environments Support backup monitoring and vendor coordination Configure and deploy IT equipment for new starters and store rollouts Assist with IT projects including system upgrades and migrations Travel to stores (VIC and interstate) when required ABOUT YOU 1-2 years of experience in IT support or service desk environments Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows environments, MacOS and Microsoft 365 Experience supporting distributed sites or multi-location businesses Highly Regarded: Experience working in a retail environment Exposure to Point of Sale (POS) systems Experience with ERP systems, specifically in fashion retail Familiarity with cyber security platforms such as Darktrace and CrowdStrike Experience with endpoint management/RMM tools such as NinjaOne Understanding of networking concepts such as WAN, LAN and SD-WAN You’re practical, calm under pressure and enjoy solving problems. You communicate clearly with non-technical users and take ownership of issues through to resolution. You’re comfortable working independently while contributing positively to a collaborative IT team. This role is based in our Cremorne office, so the successful applicant must be comfortable being in the office full time. WHY JOIN THE DREAMTEAM We are committed to providing an AMAZING working environment, empowered by five core values: Honesty, Bravery, Integrity, Innovation, and Optimism. We are passionate about our DREAMTEAM and committed to providing continuous growth and development opportunities. We aim to open the door to exciting and dynamic careers in retail, with the opportunity to learn from the best in the business. We are experiencing a period of phenomenal growth. When we grow, you grow! At DECJUBA, we’re committed to ensuring our team reflects the diversity of our customers and our community. We recognise that we do our best work together and are focused on creating an AMAZING culture that supports our team members to be themselves and perform at their best. By creating an inclusive culture, we ensure diversity in all its forms (including all abilities, culture, race, gender, age, and sexual orientation) is welcomed and celebrated and encourage applications from all candidates. Want to join the DREAMTEAM? Apply now! DECJUBA are a 2023 Circle Back Initiative Employer – we commit to respond to every applicant!

review_candidates.title: Platform Design Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description: A leading defense company is looking for a Platform Design Systems Engineer to lead the end-to-end engineering design and integration of C4I and mission equipment on military and tactical land platforms. Responsibilities : * Lead engineering activities from requirements definition and platform survey through design, prototype integration, verification, acceptance, and delivery * Define platform architecture, equipment layout, mechanical and electrical interfaces, power distribution, grounding, cable routing, accessibility, and maintainability * Translate system and customer requirements into controlled specifications, ICDs, J2J connectivity, cable lists, BOMs, drawings, and installation documentation * Coordinate multidisciplinary aspects including mechanical design, electrical infrastructure, cabling, ergonomics, safety, thermal management, weight distribution, and EMI/EMC * Lead design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, PRR) and ATP readiness, define technical SOWs, manage subcontractors, and drive technical closure * Support installation, hands-on troubleshooting, root cause analysis, validation, ATP execution, and transition to production Requirements : * B.Sc. in Mechanical, Electrical, Systems, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline * Proven experience in multidisciplinary development, platform/vehicle integration, or systems engineering * Background in military technology units with hands-on experience installing and operating communication or C4I systems inside tactical platforms – strong advantage * Knowledge of mechanical installations, electrical power distribution, grounding, cable harnesses, connectors, and interfaces * Experience with design reviews, engineering documentation, integration, verification, and acceptance activities * Ability to work at both system and detailed design levels and manage cross-discipline risks * Strong technical leadership, communication, and supplier/customer coordination skills * High proficiency in English and willingness to travel abroad.

review_candidates.description: Description About us At Datacom, we combine technology, expertise, and talented people to help organisations thrive in a rapidly changing world. This will focus on the business outcomes that can be realised by leveraging agile ways of working while providing our customers deep ongoing, proactive, strategic guidance and operational engagement and support. The Microsoft 365 Architect will work with customers to transform their business with cloud first productivity and collaborations solutions for their digital transformation journey. Providing standards and solutions to our MS 365 offering and acting as an escalation point/SME for our technology operations staff.
